$comment: Fonte única do painel. Só entra aqui o que pode ser público: nada de domínio interno, IP, nome de cliente sem autorização ou detalhe de infraestrutura. Projetos de cliente ficam anonimizados.

boot.text: 2018  > IT support: endpoints, networks, users, tickets
now   > software developer by day, SOC monitoring by night
mode  > AI-assisted engineering: design > build > verify > learn

hosts.name: gym-app
hosts.role: Local-first training log to track gym progress

case.problem: Log sets and loads at the gym, even with no signal, and see progress over time.
case.build: Offline-first PWA syncing to a containerized Node API; Google sign-in through Supabase Auth.
case.security: Row-level security on every table, JWTs verified via JWKS, read-only containers with dropped capabilities, secret scan in CI.

hosts.name: devhome
hosts.role: Reproducible dev environment with its own security monitor

case.problem: One environment that rebuilds from scratch and tells me when it drifts from a secure baseline.
case.build: Bootstrap scripts, a findings collector with tickets and accepted-risk rules, a lessons KB and AI agent skills.
case.security: Pre-commit secret scanning, findings ranked by severity, every change closed by a verification report.

hosts.name: space-agent
hosts.role: Modular local AI agent: CLI, SQLite FTS5, Ollama

case.problem: An assistant with memory that runs on my machine instead of a third-party cloud.
case.build: Typer CLI over a modular core: SQLite with FTS5 for local search, Ollama for local models, contracts for MCP and webhooks.
case.security: Local models by default, configuration by environment, structured logs for audit.

hosts.name: prova.ai
hosts.role: Virtual try-on SaaS: landing, web app and API

case.problem: Let shoppers preview a garment on themselves before buying.
case.build: Split into landing page, web app and .NET API; demo flow from login to upload to try-on result.
case.security: API separated from the front end, uploads handled server-side, secrets kept out of the client bundle.

hosts.name: law-firm-site
hosts.role: Law firm website: v2 rebuild with own static build

case.problem: Replace a template site with a fast, accessible one the client can trust for leads.
case.build: Dependency-free static build with a single layout, deployed to Cloudflare; staging kept out of search engines.
case.security: No backend to attack, consent mode for analytics, legal review gate on privacy policy and terms before launch.

hosts.name: sports-landing
hosts.role: Carbon wheels landing page for a sports brand

case.problem: Present a premium product line with motion, without a heavy page.
case.build: Static page with GSAP scroll animation and optimized media on Cloudflare Pages.
case.security: Static hosting only, external links isolated, no third-party form handlers.

log.msg: monitor now flags stale backups, failed triage and uncommitted lessons
api node provisioned: hardened host, read-only containers
auth wired: Google OAuth + Supabase, legacy keys disabled
v2 deployed to staging, awaiting client sign-off
landing page shipped for review (static, Cloudflare)
demo flow live: login > upload > try-on > result
